item.title: REF 0.3.0
item.description:
• Both songs' waveforms under the files, coloured by frequency (lows red, mids green, highs blue), with a red mark wherever a true peak goes over 0 dB.
  • Listen A/B: click a waveform to play from there, then flip between the reference and your mix (R / M, Space plays), level-matched so the louder one doesn't win.
  • A cooler look: Steel by default, plus Midnight, Carbon and the old amber Warehouse, dark or light, with texture and waveform colour choices (Settings › Look).
  • True peak is judged against your reference: going over 0 dB like the reference does is a note, not a problem. Settings › True peak brings back the −1 dBTP rule.
  • From REF Send: with the REF Send plug-in last on your master bus, every pass you play is measured when you stop. No bouncing.
  • Compare a part of a song (a looped chorus, say) with the matching part of the reference, or drag to pick the part.
